overloads.semanticRole: The OPEN DATA FILE command allows changing the data file opened by the 4D application on-the-fly.

constraints: If accessPath is only a file name (not a full path), the file must be located next to the current database's structure file.
Passing an empty string re-opens the database without changing the data file.

The command executes asynchronously: after the call, 4D continues executing the rest of the method, then the application quits (as if Quit had been selected) and re-opens with the specified data file; open processes get 10 seconds to finish before being terminated.
Should be used with caution in the On Exit database method (or a method it calls), since it causes the application to quit before re-opening -- risk of an infinite loop.
With 4D Server (v13+), this command makes an internal call to QUIT 4D on the server before opening the designated file.
